name: Chemistry Question Generation Platform — Phase 1: Knowledge Extraction

parameters.formDescription: Uploads a chapter PDF and produces a structured CHAPTER_KNOWLEDGE.json on Google Drive. Phase 1 does NOT generate questions — it only extracts, cleans, and structures the chapter knowledge. All 11 form fields are stored on the output so later phases can reuse them.

values.option: Classification of Elements and Periodicity in Properties
Organic Chemistry - Some Basic Principles and Techniques

values.fieldValue:
You are a chemistry chapter structurer. Given the cleaned text of one CBSE chemistry chapter you must output STRICT JSON only — no prose, no markdown, no code fences — matching this schema EXACTLY:

{
  "chapter_title": string,                  // exact title as it appears
  "topics": [string],                         // major topics, in reading order
  "subtopics": [{ "topic": string, "name": string, "summary": string }],
  "definitions": [{ "term": string, "definition": string, "topic": string }],
  "formulae": [{ "name": string, "expression": string, "variables": string, "topic": string }],
  "laws": [{ "name": string, "statement": string, "topic": string }],
  "principles": [{ "name": string, "statement": string, "topic": string }],
  "reactions": [{ "name": string, "equation": string, "conditions": string, "topic": string }],
  "examples": [{ "title": string, "summary": string, "working": string, "topic": string }],
  "tables": [{ "label": string, "summary": string, "rows": [string], "topic": string }],
  "graph_references": [{ "label": string, "describes": string, "topic": string }],
  "diagram_references": [{ "label": string, "describes": string, "topic": string }],
  "important_facts": [{ "fact": string, "topic": string }],
  "exceptions": [{ "rule": string, "exception": string, "topic": string }],
  "ncert_activities": [{ "label": string, "summary": string, "topic": string }]
}

RULES:
- Use ONLY content found in the supplied cleaned text. Never invent facts, constants, or examples.
- Preserve exact NCERT terminology, IUPAC names, SI units, and numerical values.
- Preserve chemistry notation in plain text using NCERT conventions (H2O, H2SO4, [Cu(NH3)4]2+, Δ, →, ⇌, °C, mol·L⁻¹).
- Keep formulae and reactions on a single line; do not introduce LaTeX.
- For every entry, set the `topic` field to the closest matching item in `topics` (or empty string if uncertain).
- If a section is absent in the chapter, return an empty array — do not omit the key.
- Do not summarise the entire chapter into a single blob; decompose into the arrays above.
- Do not include headers, page numbers, copyright notices, or layout artefacts.
- Output must parse with JSON.parse on the first try.

nodes.name: Extract PDF Text & Metadata
nodes.notes: Joins all pages into $json.text and exposes PDF metadata (numpages, info, version) on $json. Retries 3× on transient parser failures.

nodes.name: AI: Structure Chapter Knowledge
nodes.notes: Single LLM call (Haiku, temperature 0). Produces the structured knowledge object per the schema in SYSTEM_STRUCTURER. Retries once on transient 5xx.

parameters.jsCode:
const ctx = $json;
return [{ json: {
  status: 'OK',
  phase: 1,
  batch_id: ctx.batch_id,
  chapter: ctx.chapter,
  chapter_code: ctx.chapter_code,
  saved_file: ctx.knowledge_file_name,
  drive_file_id: ctx.id,
  drive_web_view_link: ctx.webViewLink,
  drive_folder_trail: ctx.drive_folder_trail,
  pdf_pages: ctx.pdf_metadata?.num_pages,
  total_structured_entries: ctx.final_payload?.meta?.total_structured_entries,
  finished_at: new Date().toISOString()
}}];
